title: Achieving Robust Channel Estimation Neural Networks on Doppler effects by Designed Training Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.14267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Channel estimation is crucial in wireless communication systems. Many existing works train and test their models using the same or similar channel. However, practical channels are infinitely diverse and time-variant while data-driven algorithms often degrade on new and previously unseen channels. This prohibits the practical implementation of neural networks for channel estimation, particularly in high speed scenarios characterized by rapidly channel profile changes and very high Doppler shifts. Online training can fine-tune models to adapt to new channels, but requires high computation resource and incurs significant latency for physical-layer devices. Moreover, online training cannot exhaustively cover all possible channels because there are infinitely many possible channels. Therefore, we investigate the ability of neural networks to generalize to wireless channels. This paper proposes design criteria to generate synthetic training

translated_title: 通过设计的训练数据实现抗多普勒效应的鲁棒信道估计神经网络
translated_abstract: 信道估计在无线通信系统中至关重要。许多现有工作使用相同或相似的信道来训练和测试其模型。然而，实际信道是无限多样且时变的，而数据驱动算法在新颖的、先前未见过的信道上往往会出现性能退化。这阻碍了神经网络在信道估计中的实际应用，尤其是在以信道特征快速变化和极高多普勒频移为特征的高速场景中。在线训练可以对模型进行微调以适应新信道，但需要大量计算资源，并会给物理层设备带来显著延迟。此外，由于可能的信道有无限多种，在线训练也无法穷尽覆盖所有可能的信道。因此，我们研究了神经网络对无线信道的泛化能力。本文提出了生成合成训练数据的设计准则……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一套合成训练数据的设计准则，通过精心设计的训练数据使信道估计神经网络能够泛化到未见过的时变信道，从而在具有强多普勒效应的高速场景下实现鲁棒信道估计，避免了昂贵且延迟高的在线训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes design criteria for generating synthetic training data, enabling channel estimation neural networks to generalize to unseen time-varying channels and achieve robust estimation in high-speed scenarios with severe Doppler effects, without costly and latency-inducing online training.
